description: Labeled privacy policy dataset for GDPR compliance training

domains.policy_text: GitHub Privacy Statement. We collect information directly from you for your registration and use of our Service. We collect personal data from you including your name email address username and payment information. We use your information to provide the Service communicate with you and improve our products. You have rights to access rectify erase and port your data. We retain your data as long as your account is active. We use cookies and similar technologies. We share data with service providers and as required by law. GitHub is a data controller. You can contact our Data Protection Officer. We use encryption and security measures to protect your data. You have the right to lodge a complaint with a supervisory authority.
domains.notes: Strong GDPR compliance with clear DPO contact and data subject rights
